summary: Snohomish County L-4 cab built 1936; removed or destroyed in 1967 per two sources; no source describes what remains today.

facts.status_note: The register says the cab was removed in 1967; FireLookout.com says it was destroyed that year. No source describes what remains today.

events.note: Panoramic photographs dated August 9, 1935 (register), a year before the listed build year
L-4 cab built, per the register and FireLookout.com
Register says removed; FireLookout.com says destroyed
Registered April 24, 2012; nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: about eight miles southwest of Glacier Peak
administered by the U.S. Forest Service

evidence.quote: Built in 1936, this L-4 cab was removed in 1967.
Red Ridge Lookout panoramic 8-9-1935 (N) - courtesy of National Archives-Pacific Northwest Region

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the cab was removed in 1967; FireLookout.com says it was destroyed in 1967. The story uses the register's word and reports both.

notes_for_editor: Only two short records exist in our sources, and they agree on the 1936 build and 1967 loss. The register's panoramas are dated August 9, 1935, a year before the build year; the sources do not explain this, so the story flags it without resolving it. The brief's 2012 registration date (April 24, 2012) checked out against the register. Two web searches turned up no staffing, fire or present-day sources. The story says plainly that no source describes the site today. The brief's kind 'ground' is the register's category; we did not verify it. Confidence low.
